headline: Zodiac Energy releases investor presentation
hook: Routine corporate update from Zodiac Energy
summary: Zodiac Energy Limited has submitted its latest investor presentation to the stock exchanges. Investor presentations provide stakeholders with details on the company's business model, financial performance, and future outlook. Such routine disclosures help retail investors track operational progress. However, they typically have a minimal direct impact on immediate stock price movement.
why_it_matters: Provides company updates for ongoing research

headline: Zodiac Energy reports financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026
hook: September quarter numbers out at Zodiac
summary: Zodiac Energy Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing provides the company's financial performance data for the second quarter of the fiscal year. Retail shareholders and market participants can review these figures on the exchange portal to assess the company's revenue and profitability trends.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data available for Zodiac Energy shareholders.

headline: Gujarat High Court quashes GST demand against Zodiac Energy for FY19
hook: Relief for Zodiac Energy on tax dispute
summary: The Gujarat High Court has set aside a Goods and Services Tax (GST) demand notice issued against Zodiac Energy for the financial year 2019. The legal challenge brought by the company resulted in the favorable ruling, removing a pending regulatory liability. For Indian retail investors, resolution of tax litigation removes uncertainty around the company's financial health and potential cash outflows.
why_it_matters: Tax liability removed for Zodiac Energy
winners_losers: Zodiac Energy gains / tax authorities hurt
